Neurocardiogenic Syncope is another term for neurally mediated syncope, which involves different mechanisms than complete atrioventricular block.
Orthostatic Hypotension is related to blood pressure regulation upon standing, which is a different issue from cardiac conduction as indicated by complete atrioventricular block.
